name: media-manager
description: Self-hosted media download manager: parallel yt-dlp queue with playlist recursion, metadata embedding and auto-resume, searchable library, recurring channel checks. FastAPI + React, Docker Compose.

name: doc-pipeline
description: Local offline document intelligence pipeline: ingest PDFs/images/CSVs, extract structured data with Ollama, validate schema + confidence, load into SQLite.

name: security-audit
description: Local network & host security scanner: discovers live hosts, scans for open ports/services, checks SSH and firewall hardening, and generates a severity-ranked Markdown audit report.

name: local-rag
description: Fully-local RAG pipeline: chunk, embed via Ollama, search vectors in Postgres/pgvector, answer with cited sources. FastAPI + SSE streaming + demo UI.
